visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with dark hair and a black striped blazer over a dark shirt stands center-frame, speaking to the camera. He is in a dark studio setting where the background is softly blurred, showing a clapperboard icon and categorical text labels like 'Education' and 'Finance'. His facial expressions are animated, and he uses active hand gestures to emphasize his speech. (2) A fast-paced montage of stock footage begins, showing a corridor in a server room with neon blue and purple lights, followed by a close-up of US dollar bills. A person in a white lab coat is shown typing on a silver laptop, and high-speed shots of blinking server racks appear. A gloved hand points at a medical vitals monitor, and military personnel are seen in a data control room looking at a large screen. (3) The main character returns to the frame, continuing his energetic address. The scene periodically cuts to close-ups of a backlit purple keyboard, a person using a smartphone, and a digital finger touching a glowing network node on a screen. The lighting remains consistent, focusing on the speaker's face. (4) An informational text card appears with event details for May 19, 2025. This is followed by a split-screen shot featuring the main character at the bottom and a headshot of an older Caucasian male with a beard and glasses (Rene Haas) at the top. (5) Technical visualizations of a car chassis and a glowing brain hologram are shown while the character speaks. The video concludes with a large QR code overlay on a dark grid background, encouraging viewer interaction.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 人類史上最大的 AI 計畫. [Logo]: @shasha77.daily. (2) [Subtitle]: 真的要開工了！. (3) [Subtitle]: 今年初美國宣布要聯合多家科技大廠. (4) [Subtitle]: 推出名為「星際之門計畫」的超級 AI 工程. (5) [Subtitle]: 這個計畫為什麼那麼重要？. (6) [Subtitle]: 因為 AI 需要海量的運算能力才能變得更強大. (7) [Subtitle]: 這個計畫將投入 5000 億美元打造超級 AI 基礎設施. (8) [Subtitle]: 從數據中心到電力網. (9) [Subtitle]: 目標是推動更強大的 AI 用在醫療、國防科研等關鍵領域. (10) [Subtitle]: 這場 AI 軍備競賽不只美國參戰. (11) [Subtitle]: 中國、法國、韓國也紛紛宣布自己的版本. (12) [Subtitle]: 全球 AI 算力軍備競賽全面開打！. (13) [Subtitle]: 而在這場比拼背後關鍵之一是「高效能、低功耗」的運算架構. (14) [Subtitle]: 而這正是 Arm 長期深耕的領域. (15) [Subtitle]: 不管是邊緣裝置、智慧手機還是超大規模的雲端資料中心. (16) [Subtitle]: Arm 的技術已經成為全球 AI 生態系不可或缺的力量. (17) [Subtitle]: 想要搶先掌握全球 AI 發展的脈動嗎？. (18) [Subtitle]: 現在就是你的最佳時機！. (19) [Subtitle]: 2025年 5月 19日 15:00 - 16:00 台北漢來大飯店. (20) [Subtitle]: 參與《星際之門》的 Arm 即將於 COMPUTEX 期間. (21) [Subtitle]: 由執行長 Rene Haas 親臨台北發表重量級主題演講！. (22) [Subtitle]: Arm 技術已應用在全球 99% 的智慧型手機與主流雲端服務上. (23) [Subtitle]: 預估 2025 年底將有超過 1000 億台 Arm 裝置具備 AI 運算能力！. (24) [Subtitle]: Arm 執行長將於演講中揭示 AI、雲端與汽車領域的最新趨勢. (25) [Subtitle]: 並分享 Arm 如何協助產業提升 AI 效能，推動生態系蓬勃發展. (26) [Slogan]: 掃描 QR Code 前往報名頁面. (27) [Variety]: 演講每年都爆滿. [Variety]: 早鳥報到還有神秘禮喔！. (28) [Variety]: 趕快到資訊欄查看報名資訊立刻報名吧!
